about: From July 8 2026, Clubs will no longer be available to play in DiRT Rally 2.0. This is due to the game's website, where Clubs are hosted, being sunset on that date.
If you try to access Racenet Clubs in-game after this date, you will receive an error message and be unable to play that game mode.
All other online functionalities within DiRT Rally 2.0, such as Time Trial, My Team Career and Quick Play Multiplayer, will continue to be playable.
For further information on online service updates in EA games, please visit https://www.ea.com/legal/service-updates.
